model_annotation: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating an “effect” value across multiple language-family categories for six model/setting variants, with uncertainty shown via vertical error bars on each bar. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups in left-to-right order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with major tick marks at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30, spanning roughly from slightly below 0 (about −5) up to the mid-30s. Within each category, six side-by-side bars are shown in the legend order and colors: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). Approximate bar heights by category are: IE-Baltic ≈1–2 (mBERT-L₂), ≈1 (XLM-L₂), ≈3 (mBERT-R₂), ≈3 (XLM-R₂), ≈6 (mBERT-B₂), ≈5 (XLM-B₂); IE-Germanic ≈9–10 (mBERT-L₂), ≈10 (XLM-L₂), near 0 (mBERT-R₂), slightly below 0 (XLM-R₂), ≈15 (mBERT-B₂), ≈15 (XLM-B₂); IE-Indic ≈1 (mBERT-L₂), around 0 to slightly below (XLM-L₂), ≈20 (mBERT-R₂), ≈18 (XLM-R₂), ≈24 (mBERT-B₂), ≈21 (XLM-B₂); IE-Romance ≈6 (mBERT-L₂), ≈4 (XLM-L₂), ≈5 (mBERT-R₂), ≈1 (XLM-R₂), ≈12–13 (mBERT-B₂), ≈5–6 (XLM-B₂); IE-Slavic family ≈10–11 (mBERT-L₂), ≈9 (XLM-L₂), ≈1 (mBERT-R₂), near 0 (XLM-R₂), ≈17 (mBERT-B₂), ≈15–16 (XLM-B₂); IE-other ≈6 (mBERT-L₂), ≈6 (XLM-L₂), around 0 (mBERT-R₂), around 0 (XLM-R₂), ≈8 (mBERT-B₂), ≈8 (XLM-B₂); Isolate bars are all close to zero with small positives around ≈1–2 for the green/pink/red series; Semitic shows ≈11 (mBERT-L₂), ≈16 (XLM-L₂), negative values around ≈−2 to −1 (mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂), ≈15 (mBERT-B₂), and ≈19–20 (XLM-B₂); Uralic bars are small, roughly ≈0.5–1 for the blue/green series and ≈2 for the pink series. Error bars vary in length across series and categories, with notably large intervals in several groups such as IE-Indic and Semitic (e.g., the Semitic XLM-L₂ bar’s error bar extending from roughly the mid-single-digits to the high-20s). The bars are presented in fixed category order (not visually sorted by magnitude), and no individual bars appear specially highlighted beyond their color coding and error bars.
